beats.text: Sitting next to Zelenskyy and half of Europe, Trump dropped his favorite stat: six wars, solved, personally, by him.

beats.caption: You know, I've done six wars. I've ended six wars.
beats.label: via ANI News

beats.text: Six wars in six months. No peace prize yet, but he's applied.

beats.caption: Look, India, Pakistan, we're talking about big places.
beats.label: via ANI News

beats.text: One catch: India says he didn't broker anything -- credit goes to its own military, not him.

beats.caption: President Trump claimed once again that he has ended six wars since taking office.
beats.label: via WION

beats.text: Claim number nine, and fact-checkers who reviewed his own list found some of those wars weren't even raging when he says he ended them.

beats.caption: India has repeatedly rejected the idea that Trump negotiated the ceasefire.
beats.label: via WION

beats.text: Six wars claimed. Zero independently confirmed.
